title: Container Bookings: Loading Priority, Guarantees and Empty Release Settings by Tier
content:
For each Container Bookings product this page records how firmly the line protects space and equipment and how the release of empty containers is timed and secured.

## Protection and release table

| Booking product | Loading priority rank | Space guaranteed against overbooking rolls | Booked equipment type guaranteed at depot | 40HC issued free when 40DV is short | Earliest empty release (calendar days before scheduled departure) | Cash-in-advance customer must clear charges before release |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Spot Saver | 6 | no | no | no | 7 | yes |
| AHL Spot Flex | 5 | no | no | yes | 7 | yes |
| AHL Contract Booking | 4 | no | no | yes | 10 | no |
| AHL Contract Priority | 3 | no | yes | yes | 10 | no |
| AHL Guaranteed Loading | 2 | yes | yes | yes | 10 | yes |
| AHL Premium Express | 1 | yes | yes | yes | 12 | no |

## Notes on the columns

- **Loading priority rank** orders the protection of bookings on an overbooked sailing: rank 1 is shielded ahead of every other rank, rank 6 last.
- **Space guaranteed** applies to AHL Guaranteed Loading and AHL Premium Express only.
- **Equipment guaranteed** covers the three products ranked 1 to 3 for loading priority.
- **Free substitution** means the line may hand out a 40HC in place of a booked 40DV without extra charge when 40DV units are short; only AHL Spot Saver lacks it.
- **Earliest empty release** is counted back from the scheduled departure date in whole calendar days.
- **Clearing charges before release** concerns customers whose credit standing is cash in advance; the column says whether the product holds such customers to it.

## Basis Q&A

**Does every product with guaranteed equipment also have guaranteed space?** No. AHL Contract Priority guarantees the booked equipment type but not space against overbooking rolls.

**Which product has the widest release window?** AHL Premium Express, whose empties may go out twelve calendar days ahead of departure.
